name: NORDIC TERN at Exampleville (synthetic tariff, generalisation test)
query: What will the general cargo ship NORDIC TERN (Norway flag, built 2016) pay at Exampleville? She is 18,400 GT and 9,950 NT, 24,000 DWT, 172.5 m long with a 27 m beam and a 9.8 m draft, and has an Environmental Ship Index score of 35. She arrives on 10 March 2025 at 08:00 and leaves on 17 March 2025 at 06:00, spending 6.4 days alongside to discharge 12,000 tonnes of steel coils.

expected.label: Harbour dues
expected.note: ceil(9,950 / 100) = 100 units: 100 × 4.20 = 420.00; days beyond the fifth: ceil(6.4 − 5) = 2, so 100 × 0.60 × 2 = 120.00; 540.00 less the 10% ESI reduction = 486.00

expected.label: Pilotage
expected.note: LOA 172.5 m is in the 100.01–200 m band: 2,450.00 × 2 operations

expected.label: Towage
expected.note: 18,400 GT → 2 tugs → 3,150.00 per operation × 2 operations (towage is compulsory over 120 m LOA)

expected.label: Waste reception fee
expected.note: flat per call; no exemption certificate
